## Tour highlights

Get to know Bogotá through La Candelaria, the Gold Museum, the Botero Museum, Plaza de Bolívar and the climb up Monserrate. In Villa de Leyva, see old colonial buildings and the large historic square, then explore nearby sites such as Casa Terracota and the El Infiernito archaeological complex.

In the coffee region, you’ll see the wax palms of the Cocora Valley and the colourful town of Salento. At a coffee farm, follow the process from seedling to roasting and tasting.

Santa Marta and Tayrona National Park bring a change of scenery, with jungle, coral reefs, beaches and the Caribbean Sea. In Cartagena, see the city walls, La Popa Hill and San Felipe de Barajas Castle. On a separate day, visit a fishing village to catch fish and crabs and prepare lunch with local residents.
